name: Wu Xu
bio: Received a Master's degree in Bioinformatics and Computational Biology and a Ph.D. in Genetics/Biochemistry from Iowa State University, followed by postdoctoral training in the Department of Biochemistry at St. Jude Children's Hospital. Dr. Xu's research interest is understanding protein function and structure relation in the context of signal transduction using a combination of experimental and computational approaches, focusing on the molecular mechanism of electron transfer in photosystem I and on developing the TSR-based computational method for probing molecular interactions.
